newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Petrol Ofisi to increase capital.
newsitem.headline: Turk Petrol Ofisi to increase capital.

text.p: Turkish lubricants producer and petroleum products marketer, state-run Petrol Ofisi A.S will distribute rights and bonuses to raise its capital to seven trillion lira from 2.52 trillion lira.
In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, the company said its executive board decided to issue 1.3777 rights and 0.4 bonus for one existing share.
The increase must be approved by the regulatory Capital Market Board (SPK) before taking effect. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
